  D1 embed-core+acquire         STALLED grok-4.6-help, no operation since 15:06 (112 min)

SLICE E CARRIED MORE THAN ITS SCOPE and that is worth recording on the parent, because the sub-shape
(a) estimate did not anticipate it: as well as building the construction path, it folded a SECOND
LAW -- the atlas/transcript identity check, found only because the author was blocked and did static
review instead of compiling. That law is in its own commit (37edf3c) so the expansion is visible and
independently revertible.

THE SUB-SHAPE PREDICTION HELD. (b) was one line plus a probe; (a) required building a construction
path every time. A was 2 files, B was 12, E was 38. Anyone taking C, D1 or D2 should size against B
and E, not A.

CHECKPOINT ON C AND D1 AT 17:25Z. Prepared: slice-c-unforgeable has ZERO commits ahead of main --
nothing to inherit. slice-d-unforgeable has FOUR commits, 329 insertions of real LatePoolingRecipe
work, safe on a ref because its author followed the commit-to-a-branch convention before
disappearing. So the two decisions differ: reassigning C costs nothing; reassigning D1 means handing
someone an absent author's half-finished design. My stated position is propose reassignment for C,
leave D1 intact until tomorrow.
